That I been through... do you...
Love me?
Is there anything on anyone above me?
Do you? Need me?
Will you take some time to teach me what I've left to learn?
Will you stop playing with fire
Because I'm so sick and tired of gettin' burned
I've been stared at into my soul by a liar
I've lost all control trying to get higher
I'm finally within reach of [?] aspire
It's now smooth sailing where once the straights were dire
---
Mother may she sleep in peace
May her spirit be at ease
When you get a call in the middle of the night
The hospital called but she's not alright
Fly, Fly away raven
Go on home back to your safe haven
Fly, Fly away raven
Go on home your work here is done
Mourning in the evening
Mourning at noon
Mourning in the morning
Over a life taken much to soon
A wedding and a funeral
Only three weeks a part
The end of a life
Just as another one starts

cards.typed_words:
wilted rose
UNTITLED
On the table - a twelve inch blade
As night creeps in as black as spades
Would it really matter, one slip of the knife?
Would anyone notice, a worthless life?
Her inner voice has let her down
Left alone with no one around
With all the pain built up inside
Now discovered with nowhere to hide

From some pains you can never run away
Though sometimes forgotten, the scars will always stay
For sometimes there's no escape
And all it takes is a simple mistake
To burn down the mansion you built
And to knock the clown off his stilts
She lies on the floor, last thoughts so guilted
Clutching a rose now fallen wilted

Inspired by a passing thought of last night's World Lit 1 class when we watched
the movie Edipus Rex. I was thinking how his mother/wife killed herself. The
similarities stop there, though. It has a little understating in it too. The wilted rose
shows she died yet I did not mention it - it is assumed. Later I may add another
stanza or two but I kinda like it. I couldn't think of a title though.

cards.typed_words:
THIS SLICE OF HEAVEN
I can take you to the place you see
We could both be there in harmony
No longer will you have to search your memory
I can turn dreams into reality
Come and follow me to this place
Come with me and get one sweet taste
When life's too quick slow down the pace
So I can stop and admire your pretty face
The smell of the leaves blend with the sweet scent of the ocean
Please tell me what you put inside of your magical potion
After letting the waves caress our every motion
Lay by the water as I rub you with lotion
As I look out upon the sea
I know you mean the world to me
Here with you I'm finally free
Free from this world's insanity
As the day evolves into the night
My eyes take journey through another sight
The moon's silver blue hue is all around
In complete silence, noone makes a sound
I am left to hear your heartbeat pound
Cherrishing the love I've found
We always find ourselves here in the warmth of day
This place where rain and snowfall have all gone away
At the edge of a cliff like children we play
Right here, forever, is where I will stay
We'll stay forever and live by the sea
We'll stay forever just you and me
There's no other place I'd rather be
This slice of heaven is called home to me

cards.typed_words:
ALISON'S AIRPLANE
I find my religion in the basement of churches
Never mind a pew

Here I sit trying to learn from my mistakes
God knows I've made a few

If you'd made as many as I have
Then you'd probably sit here too

Here I sit and reminisce it all
Biding my time by reading
Slogans on the wall

A higher power is what I need
Something above myself can set me free

You can only tell what you're really worth
When you realize that you're not the center of the earth

The sun does not rise for you
No matter how much you want it to

Gravity was made for many reasons
Something to do with the sun, the moon
And the changing of the seasons

It may be true that it pulls you down
But in order to walk the road ahead
First your feet must meet the ground

Then the rest is up to you
Use your better judgment if you want to
From which you came

If you choose to walk back down the road
Don't point your finger at me
That finger of blame

Alison told me she had an airplane
Of course I didn't believe it
So I asked her to teach me how to fly
But she told me I couldn't see it
---
She said if you want to go for a ride
First you must know that the airplane's inside
At the time I didn't quite know just what she meant
But now I realize that Alison's Airplane is Heaven sent
